The '''Dome of Crystal Fire''' was a gargantuan cave deep below the [[Torragan Mountains]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aurea]]. Burning crystals covered the walls, creating a dazzling display of constantly shifting [[Color/Legends|colored]] lights. It was believed that the overall colors and patterns changed based on the spirits of those within the cave. The leaders of the [[Soulworks Collective Advisory Council]] declared the Dome a protected space: limiting access with trained guides and armed guards to protect the entire chamber.
